Not a wave defect: TinyHttpd's default host allowlist answers 421 before middleware for an empty Host, the same adapter defence SEC-PROXY-001 AC-8 accepts; the proxy never runs. The proxy's own empty-Host rule is shown over the in-memory adapter (ProxyHostHeaderTest fr_PROXY_004_AC4_anEmptyHostCountsAsNoHost) and HTTP/1.0 no-Host over TinyHttpd is green (LP-5).

Observation for a later wave: a client-sent X-Forwarded-Host is passed through ahead of the proxy's own line. Removing or replacing client forwarding headers belongs to SEC-PROXY-002 / FR-PROXY-003 AC-8, open until wave-19 (FR-PROXY-003 change note). AC-1 itself (the backend gets X-Forwarded-Host: <received Host>) holds.
